visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable/source-terrain frames. Individual Košice Gothic cruciform body, polygonal eastern choir and lower aisle/chapel perimeter; red tile roof with coarse ochre, slate and cream diamond rhythms. Unequal western towers retain the tall northern staged clock tower, dark onion crown with gold ribs and open upper lantern, and lower southern tower with dark pyramidal cap. The slender central fleche has an open lower stage. Three deep timber portals, pointed lights and blind tracery, ornamental gables, stone buttresses/pinnacles and sparse parapets carry the facade. Corrected large square roof colors, repeated parapet-band geometry, southern portal openings hidden behind its projecting front, gable details outside their triangles, roof slope disagreement at the crossing, and unfilled buttress roof notches. Roof notches are simplified while all raw map vertices remain source controls. Fine sculpture, inscriptions, glass art and interiors are excluded or approximate.
